'''Saban 21 (March 8)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Rand]] and [[Lan]] confront [[Padan Fain]] in [[Far Madding]]. Fain is wounded and Rand and Lan are captured by guards. Cadsuane negotiates their release.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Perrin]]'s forces arrive at [[Bryton]] behind the [[Shaido]].
